messages.subject: apply a pmml model
parts: Hi, Imagine I have built a prediction model and saved it as pmml. Now, I want to write a web based app by shiny so that those with no knowledge of R an modeling can input their data and get a prediction. Do you have any example? I do not want the users to have any access to my data or model.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: apply a pmml model
parts: I don't have any knowledge of pmml. But in general, if you can write an R script to do it, you can write a shiny app to wrap it--and no, your code and data will not be available to users unless you want it to be (or you write a security hole into your app, like calling eval() on user input).
